about: Answer sheet for the beachhead suggester: for a pitch, which 'who' segment is the best first customer. Scored by scripts/check_segment_cases.py. `accept` is the set that counts as right — more than one entry means either is defensible. `reject` names a plausible-looking wrong answer the suggester has actually given or could give. `blind` marks pitches the keyword table matches nothing on.

cases.pitch: A free second-chance matric programme for adults who left school without finishing.
A paid learnership programme for unemployed youth aged 18 to 29.
The old age pension and child support grant each rise by R50 a month.
A R99 a month maths tutoring app for matric learners.
The school nutrition programme is extended to weekends and school holidays.
A premium gym in Sandton at R1,200 a month with personal trainers.
A school engagement app for parents at independent schools that shows their child's daily effort so parents can reward it.
Parents get a tax deduction for private school fees.
The city doubles permit fees for street traders and moves them off main roads.
Low-interest loans of up to R50,000 for informal traders and township businesses.
A delivery platform that hires township youth as motorbike delivery drivers.
R5 daily data bundles for young people who cannot afford monthly contracts.
A retirement annuity product for salaried professionals with tax benefits.
A mobile app that links communal and emerging farmers to livestock buyers.
Free foot-and-mouth vaccines for cattle owners in rural areas.
An extra monthly grant for grandmothers raising their grandchildren.
A R60-a-month burial plan sold at minibus ranks, paid by debit order.
An affordable day-care place for babies and toddlers so mothers can go back to work.
A bulk-buying club where neighbours pool money monthly and split a wholesale grocery order.
Cover for minibus owners that pays out while a damaged vehicle is off the road.
Hire a tractor by the hour instead of buying one, booked by phone call.
Spread a big prepaid electricity top-up over four weekly payments at no extra cost.
A WhatsApp line where a tutor answers one homework question a day, free for the first term.
Round-the-clock armed response for plots and smallholdings outside town.
